title: BENZEMA WON THE 2022 BALLON D'OR BY 356 POINTS. THEN CAME THE KART JOKE
description:
Benzema's CV reads like a highlights reel. Then there's the Giroud karting line.

Karim Benzema won the 2022 Ballon d'Or by 356 points. Call it a lap of honour, not a win.

In 2024-25 he scored 21 league goals in 28 games for Al-Ittihad and won the league and King's Cup double. At Al-Hilal he scored a hat-trick on debut in a 6-0 win. Six months later, he was gone. Fast car, short race.

Back in 2020 he compared Olivier Giroud to karting, and himself to Formula One. Modest as ever.

Now his Saudi ambassador deal pays about 23 million dollars a year. Play abroad and it's cancelled. Formula One, parked in a very comfy pit lane.

Was the Giroud line cheeky banter or a step too far? Pick a side below.
